newsitem.title: BELGIUM: U.S. Fed's Greenspan to speak in Belgium Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Fed's Greenspan to speak in Belgium Jan 14.

text.p: Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan is due to receive an honorary degree from Belgian Leuven KUL University on January 14, the University said on Tuesday.
The presentation will be followed by an academic seminar during which Greenspan will speak on "Central Banking and Global Finance."

Invitees to the seminar also include European Monetary Institute President Alexandre Lamfalussy, Dutch central bank governor Wim Duisenberg, who has also been named Lamfalussy's successor, and Belgian central bank governor Alfons Verplaetse.
